title: Ptolemaic Supply Commissioner
subtitle: Keeper of Ptolemy's Lifelines
bodyText: A supply commissioner coordinates stores and transport across competing demands. Judgment turns figures on a tablet into provisions where they are needed, giving Ptolemy's government the material strength to maintain its hold on Egypt.
sceneBrief: A supply commissioner checks a grain consignment and its seal while comparing the shipment with a wooden writing tablet. Keep the chin gently lowered and the gaze directed toward the inspected seal and records, with a relaxed neck aligned naturally above the shoulders. Preserve the hands, tablet, grain sacks, scales and harbour.
